programs.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci Quiz"
programs.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. How long can a person exist without water? How fast is the International Space Station travelling through space? What exactly are DNA Forensics?

programs.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci IQ"
programs.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. On average, how deep are our oceans? What was the largest earthquake ever measured on the Richter scale? What is an apex predator?

programs.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci World"
programs.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. What’s the hairiest animal on the planet? What is the most common cause of the waves in the ocean? Why does the surface of Mars look red?

programs.title: Sci Q S1 - "Pop Sci Test"
programs.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. Do you know what causes an avalanche? What is the lightest element in the universe, hydrogen or helium? What was the main purpose of the Space Shuttle Program?

programs.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Engineering Earth"
programs.desc: A heroic bid for freedom by an enslaved couple in 19th century America precipitates great innovation that culminates in people literally making heavens open. But can controlling the weather save us from climate catastrophe? Or are we playing god?

programs.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Becoming Bionic"
programs.desc: From dissecting stolen corpses and peering into microscopes, the secret structure of the brain and nervous system is exposed. Could this lead to a race of superhumans?
